method: Manual key-by-key English/Russian meaning and Russian government/agreement review plus executable ICU AST, placeholder/type parity, formatter, Latin allowlist and bidi assertions. No rendered UI claim.

badge_context.conclusion: Row label is a sibling span and state text sits alone in Badge. Добавлено/Обновлено are impersonal result predicates, not adjectives requiring masculine агент/feminine команда agreement. Both are genuinely gender-neutral here.
